title: Restoring the urinary creatinine denominator did not establish grip-strength prediction gains beyond albumin–creatinine ratio
abstract: Spot urinary creatinine did not establish incremental combined-grip prediction beyond flexible demographics, anthropometry, serum creatinine and ACR: source CV MSE gain -0.109877 kg²; separate-sample target MSE gain 0.047263 kg² (400 source+target PSU-refit 95% interval -0.313567 to 0.343086). Same-program independent-sample testing, not untouched external-cohort confirmation or equivalence.
